quick_warnings: Water quality at the main beach can be poor after rains; check local advisories before swimming.
Streets are narrow and mostly unpaved — wear sturdy sandals and watch for puddles in rainy season.
PVR airport is ~45 min away; arrange transfers in advance during peak season.

detail_guide.getting_around: Sayulita is a small walkable town. Golf carts and ATVs can be rented for exploring nearby beaches. Buses and colectivos connect to Puerto Vallarta and surrounding towns along the Riviera Nayarit.

top_sights.name: Playa Sayulita
top_sights.description: The main surf beach with consistent beginner-friendly waves, board rentals, and a lively scene.

top_sights.name: Playa de los Muertos
top_sights.description: A short walk south over the hill leads to a quieter, cleaner beach ideal for snorkeling and relaxing.

top_sights.name: Islas Marietas (day trip)
top_sights.description: Protected island reserve famous for the Hidden Beach; boat tours depart from Punta de Mita nearby.

parks.name: Cerro del Mono (Monkey Mountain)
parks.description: A jungle trail leading to panoramic views of Sayulita and the coast; watch for wild parrots and iguanas.

eat_drink_work.name: Don Pedro's
eat_drink_work.description: Beachfront institution serving fresh ceviche, fish tacos, and craft cocktails with ocean views.

eat_drink_work.name: ChocoBanana
eat_drink_work.description: Popular bakery and cafe with strong coffee, pastries, and a shaded patio — good for remote work.

eat_drink_work.name: Sayulita Cafe
eat_drink_work.description: Laid-back cafe with reliable Wi-Fi, smoothie bowls, and a digital-nomad-friendly atmosphere.

quick_warnings: La calidad del agua en la playa principal puede ser mala después de lluvias; consulta los avisos locales antes de nadar.
Las calles son estrechas y en su mayoría sin pavimentar — usa sandalias resistentes y cuidado con los charcos en temporada de lluvias.
El aeropuerto de PVR está a ~45 min; organiza traslados con anticipación durante temporada alta.

detail_guide.getting_around: Sayulita es un pueblo pequeño que se recorre a pie. Se pueden rentar carritos de golf y cuatrimotos para explorar playas cercanas. Camiones y colectivos conectan con Puerto Vallarta y pueblos aledaños a lo largo de la Riviera Nayarit.

top_sights.name: Playa Sayulita
top_sights.description: La playa principal para surfear con olas consistentes para principiantes, renta de tablas y un ambiente animado.

top_sights.name: Playa de los Muertos
top_sights.description: Una corta caminata al sur cruzando la colina lleva a una playa más tranquila y limpia, ideal para snorkel y relajarse.

top_sights.name: Islas Marietas (excursión de un día)
top_sights.description: Reserva insular protegida famosa por la Playa Escondida; los tours en lancha salen de Punta de Mita, cerca de aquí.

parks.name: Cerro del Mono
parks.description: Un sendero selvático que lleva a vistas panorámicas de Sayulita y la costa; observa loros silvestres e iguanas.

eat_drink_work.name: Don Pedro's
eat_drink_work.description: Institución frente al mar que sirve ceviche fresco, tacos de pescado y cócteles artesanales con vista al océano.

eat_drink_work.name: ChocoBanana
eat_drink_work.description: Popular panadería y cafetería con buen café, repostería y un patio sombreado — ideal para trabajo remoto.

eat_drink_work.name: Sayulita Cafe
eat_drink_work.description: Cafetería relajada con Wi-Fi confiable, bowls de smoothie y un ambiente amigable para nómadas digitales.
